Amodei Secures $20 Million for Reno-Tahoe Airport Authority Terminal Modernization Project
May 22, 2026
|
Press Release

Washington, D.C. – Today, Rep. Mark Amodei announced $20 million in funding for the Reno-Tahoe International Airport after years of work to advance this priority.

The investment is part of nearly $1 billion Secretary Duffy has announced as part of the Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act Airport Terminal Program.
